info.title: Future You API
info.description: Engine and API for Future You (PNC 360° Financial Health Navigator).

post.description: Apply a what-if to the plan path. What-ifs stack until /api/reset.

Schedule a simulated transfer (no real money moves). Refused unless confirmed is exactly true, the amount is a
$25 step up to $1,000, and it goes from the customer's checking account to their savings account.
Stop a scheduled (simulated) transfer. 404 if there's no such transfer.
Clear what-ifs and scheduled transfers: back to the starting demo state.
How long each future's cushion would last without pay. Changes nothing.
Answer the two setup questions; indicators 7 and 8 (and the futures) re-score. Reset restores them.

rate.title: Rate
rate.description: APY for deposits, APR for debts, in percent

unused.title: Unused

total_interest.title: Total Interest
total_interest.description: Interest paid over the whole loan

chosen.title: Chosen

down.title: Down

CarPurchase.title: CarPurchase

date.title: Date

text.title: Text

cash_series.title: Cash Series

overdraft_risk_90d.description: Chance checking drops below $0 in the next 90 days

down_payment.title: Down Payment
down_payment.description: Down payment in dollars; must be below the price

value.description: The measured value, e.g. 78% card use

shared.title: Shared

Math.title: Math

source.title: Source
source.description: Where it came from, e.g. 'Spend account balance'

effects.title: Effects

amount_metric.description: The amount with why it's that amount, id 'next_step.amount'

key_numbers.title: Key Numbers

summary.title: Summary

bills.title: Bills

totals.title: Totals
totals.description: e.g. net worth, total cash, total debt

account_metrics.title: Account Metrics
account_metrics.description: Each account balance as a Metric, id 'account.<id>.balance'

runway.description: Months of no pay that checking + savings would cover

from_account_id.title: From Account Id

to_account_id.title: To Account Id
